ranked.headline: Learned molecular representations drive generation and property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph and Transformer molecular representations with generative design, benchmarking and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Generative and transport models infer single-cell trajectories and spatial cell states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair generative, transport, and contrastive models with spatial and multiomic single-cell data to model cell-state dynamics.

ranked.headline: Computational tools reshape microbiome profiling from reference curation to workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release curated references, integrated workflows, and statistical consensus tools for reproducible microbiome profiling.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models link sequence and chromatin context to regulatory genomic readouts
ranked.summary: Predictive genomic models are being built to expose which sequence, chromatin, and fragmentation features drive their outputs.

ranked.headline: Causal and probabilistic models infer dependencies across single-cell and omics data
ranked.summary: Causal discovery, factor models, and deep generative models are now applied to perturbation and multi-omics data at single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic and network models rank therapeutic targets and repurposing candidates
ranked.summary: Network and mechanistic models are increasingly used to nominate existing drugs and gene targets from integrated biological data.

ranked.headline: Transformers and LLMs are applied to genomic, molecular and clinical prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair zero-shot LLMs, sparse autoencoders and graph transformers with imaging, genomic and knowledge-graph data for biomedical prediction.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory activity from long-read, MPRA, and population-scale functional data
ranked.summary: Long-read methylation, MPRA, and single-cell assays now pair with deep learning to resolve regulatory variant effects across tissues and species.

ranked.headline: Graph-based and multimodal models predict protein function and drug-target interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications combine graph neural networks with sequence, language-model and pre-training features for biological prediction.

ranked.headline: SE(3)-equivariant diffusion models generate antibody, ligand, and protein structures
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a journal article extend SE(3)-equivariant diffusion from single structures toward ensembles, dynamics, and docking poses.

ranked.headline: Neural models decode raw sequencing signals and pathogen genome sequences directly
ranked.summary: Neural models are increasingly applied to raw signal and sequence data across sequencing platforms and pathogen genomics, bypassing hand-built processing steps.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and k-mer tools expand virus, assembly, and metabarcoding analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers present tools that address genome-scale virus taxonomy, misassembly detection, and deep metabarcoding data processing.

ranked.headline: Methods infer cell-state dynamics and lineages from single-cell and cytometry data
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks and extends trajectory, lineage, annotation and transformer methods for single-cell and cytometry data.

ranked.headline: Open, reusable software standardizes omics preprocessing, QC, and batch integration
ranked.summary: Packaging preprocessing, QC, and integration steps as openly available tools makes these workflows reusable across genomics, proteomics, and scRNA-seq.

ranked.headline: Bridging predicted biomolecular structures to simulation-ready ensembles and validation
ranked.summary: Predicted structures increasingly require simulation-ready preparation and ensemble-level validation against experimental density.

ranked.headline: Web tools predict variant effects and annotate RNA structure from 3D coordinates
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published pipeline wrap structural, evolutionary, and comparative analyses in browser-accessible interfaces.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models predict microbial resistance, interactions, and effector types
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model embed sequence, phylogenetic, or interaction structure directly into microbial prediction architectures.

ranked.headline: Long-read methods and cohort data resolve complex structural variants and alleles
ranked.summary: Long-read methods and T2T-CHM13 are resolving structural and complex variation in rare-disease and population genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of microbial metabolic function from genomes and enzymes
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models, ecosystem-scale enzyme censuses, and open analysis tools now scale microbial metabolic inference across strains and communities.

ranked.headline: Deep Graph and Generative Models Learn Brain Connectome and Anatomy Representations
ranked.summary: Neuroimaging foundation models now forecast anatomy and synthesize missing connectome modalities, extending representation learning to multimodal brain data.

ranked.headline: Bacterial mobile elements show structured exchange and arms-race defense dynamics
ranked.summary: Population-scale genome collections now allow network-level and substitution-level resolution of mobile element exchange in bacteria.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models generate and interpret protein structures, motifs and antibodies
ranked.summary: Protein generative and interpretability models now produce symmetric backbones, functional motifs and paired antibody chains.

ranked.headline: Temperature reshapes non-CG methylation diversity in Arabidopsis methylomes
ranked.summary: Population-scale WGBS and comparative long-read genome analyses now resolve methylation and genome architecture across species and tissues.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and in silico frameworks for evaluating nucleic acid and protein methods
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test nucleotide foundation models and RNA structure predictors against large assay, PDB-curated, and simulated reference datasets.

ranked.headline: ODE and PDE models of immunity waning, reinfection, and viral budding dynamics
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now quantify immunity build-up, waning, and reinfection to inform vaccine timing and dosing strategies.

ranked.headline: Deep learning tools automate segmentation across microscopy and histology workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair self-supervised pretraining and transformer architectures with open tooling to address annotation limits in biomedical imaging.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level genome assemblies for annelid, cricket and tunicate; scallop SNP panel
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale references are now paired with reprocessed multi-omic resources and comparative gene models across non-model invertebrates.

ranked.headline: Spatial, connectivity, and harmonization constraints in brain imaging statistics
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous multi-site and PET data require explicit spatial, connectivity, and harmonization handling before statistical modeling.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve conformational switching in ezrin, σ2R/TMEM97 and NLRP3 proteins
ranked.summary: Layered adaptive sampling, kinetic state modeling, and ML analysis now resolve asymmetric and ATP-driven conformational transitions in signaling proteins.

ranked.headline: Structure-constrained parameter inference for biological dynamical and ecological models
ranked.summary: Recent work couples inference machinery to specific model structures, from steady-state-constrained network fitting to compositional ecological data.

ranked.headline: Feedback and criticality confer robustness in polarity, gene networks and stem cells
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication formalize how feedback, canalization and criticality buffer biological networks against perturbation.

ranked.headline: Text mining and reanalysis tools make public biomedical data queryable
ranked.summary: Public literature and transcriptomic archives are being converted into deployable, queryable tools for biological network analysis.

ranked.headline: AI and physics-based models probe antibody-epitope interfaces and protein stability
ranked.summary: Generative AI design and MD screening now yield de novo antibodies and ultrastable scaffolds that can be checked against structural data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models tie resource supply and vector traits to persistence and invasion
ranked.summary: Dengue infects nearly 390 million people annually, and vector-trait and resource-supply parameters can now be examined as explicit model inputs.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map allosteric routes in DSIF-bound Pol II elongation complexes
ranked.summary: Molecular dynamics now connects histone tails, DNA sequence and polymerase factors to dynamic allosteric communication in nucleic acids.

ranked.headline: Systems-level modeling links brain organization, metabolism, and disease genetics
ranked.summary: Genome-scale neuron models, snRNA-seq atlases, and GWAS of callosal morphometry now resolve brain organization across cell, tissue, and population scales.

ranked.headline: Local rules and connectivity shape tuning heterogeneity and network dynamics
ranked.summary: Exact likelihoods for cortical tuning and local-rule models now link microscopic dynamics to emergent network organization.

ranked.headline: Consistent methods improve tree inference and quantify phylogenetic placement confidence
ranked.summary: Scalable consistent estimators and confidence assessment are being applied to gene trees, tree-of-blobs networks, and a two-million-genome SARS-CoV-2 tree.

ranked.headline: Computational models estimate circadian phase, glucose and exenatide exposure
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints apply computational models to wearable data and GLP-1R agonist pharmacokinetics for individualized metabolic prediction.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and generative models prioritize antibacterial candidates for testing
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs generative, deep learning, and LLM models with antibacterial data and experimental testing of designed compounds.
